column1: # Main menu (Caps + Option + Space). One entry per line:
# Group/Item<TAB>command. Groups can nest (A/B/Item). Commands run in bash
# with the package commands on the PATH. Save, and the menu updates at once.
# Two optional columns: ?TEST shows the entry only when TEST succeeds, and
# ✓TEST puts a check mark on it when TEST succeeds (helpers such as is_on
# and theme_is are in lib/toggle-state.sh). Your own entries go in
Capture/Copy text from a screen area
Transcode/Selected PDFs and Word files to text (for AI)
Update/Go back to a saved version

column2: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "q" using {control down, command down}'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to log out'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to shut down'
